'''Joanne''' is an NPC located in {{Location|City Square|nobold=1}}.

During the daytime (6:00 AM - 5:59 PM), she can be seen standing alone, and when interact with her, she will start talking about the shipping documents for the merchant ship. 

While at night (6:00 PM - 05:59 AM), she can be seen talking with [[Hector]] about granting him two days of free time in the [[Septimont]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During the daytime)
:'''Joanne:''' How did the shipping documents for the merchant ship to Septimont end up getting held up? Ugh, looks like I'll have to work overtime.
:{{DIcon}} Is the process for merchant ships really that strict?
:'''Joanne:''' Oh, not at all! I think the issue is with the documents I submitted.
:'''Joanne:''' Like Ragunna, Septimont is an autonomous city-state under Rinascita, and the shipping routes between the two aren't tightly regulated.
:'''Joanne:''' Sorry, I should have explained that more clearly. You might not know this, but Rinascita is a nation of a thousand islands, composed of several city-states.
:'''Joanne:''' So usually, travel between city-states is pretty smooth and frequent.
:'''Joanne:''' If you've ever been to the Ragunna port, you'd see lots of cargo ships getting ready to set sail.
:{{DIcon}} What kinds of goods do they trade between city-states?
:'''Joanne:''' It varies, depending on what resources each area has to offer.
:'''Joanne:''' For example, Ragunna's ships are mainly loaded with local spices and sulfur, as well as medicines made from rare deep-sea plants.
:'''Joanne:''' These goods are sent to Septimont in exchange for large amounts of Tacetite that Ragunna needs.
----
;(At night)
:'''Joanne:''' Hector, I'll grant you two days of free time in the Septimont.
:'''Joanne:''' Return to Ragunna on time in two days and report to me at the bank.
:'''Hector:''' Aunt Joanne... you're drilling this into my ears...
:'''Joanne:''' That's not how you address me! Mr. Hector.
:'''Hector:''' Yes, ma'am... Lady Joanne.
:'''Joanne:''' Before we set sail, you swore to Imperator.
:'''Hector:''' Hail Imperator. I, Hector, swear I'll never again bet on gladiator fights in the Septimont's underground casinos—
:'''Hector:''' Or let me perish at sea, never to return home!
:'''Joanne:''' If you're going to perish, fine. But don't drag down your colleagues or the cargo; they've done nothing wrong.
:'''Joanne:''' You can watch matches, but if I find you at the betting tables again—",
:'''Hector:''' —you'll fire me on the spot, freeze all my accounts, and have me sent to Averardo Vault's underground worksite.
:'''Joanne:''' I promised your mother I'd take care of you. Don't make her shed any more tears.
{{Dialogue End}}
